In 1999, Monica Lopez entered the insurance industry as a receptionist. By 2011, she had earned her way up to being a full fledged Account Manager specializing in Group Benefits. In 2015, she joined United Western Insurance Brokers as our Group Benefits Account Manager. Monica has extensive knowledge in Employee Benefits and is a seasoned problem solver. She is recognized for her exceptional customer care through her attention to detail and her ability to treat our clients like family.

Monica is a licensed Health & Life Agent and a Certified ACA Agent. Monica loves traveling to tropical destinations, dancing, romantic comedies & gardening. Monica and her family reside in Southern California.
